g.text: Original C: full selected-point-order diagnostic — prefix
Native per-target means and observed min–max, not confidence intervals. Blue: EC control. Orange: finite-field route.
Curve additions and doublings: call counts, including scalar multiplication
Explicit Fp multiplications and squarings: curve-field work remains separate
Curve-field inversions: calls counted, internals unexpanded
Conductor f in millions, ordinal positions; ? keeps unknown labels. Bottom numbers: target observations per arm.
Point orders vary and are certified; these samples do not isolate a causal conductor effect or establish a priced total.
